u0: Initial state: the ball still blocks the door, the agent has not acquired the matching key, and the door has never been opened. Next objective: move the blocking ball away from the door and pick up the door-matching key, in either order. Picking up the ball while empty-handed makes blocker_moved true; then drop the ball away from the door and pick up the key, because hands can hold only one object. Transitioning out of this state should only happen when the ball is moved (reward 0.1) or when both the ball is moved and the key is held (reward 0.2).
u1: Progress state: the ball has been moved but the agent is not currently carrying the matching door key. This includes having lost the key before the door was ever opened. Next objective: locate and pick up the key matching the door's color. Do not move the ball back in front of the door. Picking up the matching key transitions to u2 with reward 0.1; any other step, including moving or dropping the ball, keeps the agent here.
u2: Progress state: the ball is moved and the matching key has been held, so the door can now be unlocked and the target room reached. Next objective: with the matching key carried, toggle the door open, then free the hands by dropping the key once the door is open, enter the other room, and pick up the mission's designated box. Holding the matching key while the door is open gives reward 0.1; having the door open with empty hands and the target not yet picked up also gives reward 0.1. Losing the key while the door is still closed sends the agent back to u1, so do not drop the key before the door is open.
u3: Terminal success state: the agent has picked up the mission's designated box, the episode has ended, and the task is complete. Reward 1 was received on the transition into this state. No further action is needed; any subsequent step simply remains here.
